mapper.insert: INSERT INTO history (tx_type, amount, w_account_id, d_account_id, w_balance, d_balance) VALUES (#{txType}, #{amount}, #{withdrawAccountId}, #{depositAccountId}, #{withdrawBalance}, #{depositBalance})
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.tx_type AS txType, h.amount, h.w_account_id AS withdrawAccountId, h.d_account_id AS depositAccountId, h.w_balance AS withdrawBalance, h.d_balance AS depositBalance, h.created_at, wa.account_number AS withdrawAccountNumber, da.account_number AS depositAccountNumber FROM history h LEFT JOIN account wa ON wa.id = h.w_account_id LEFT JOIN account da ON da.id = h.d_account_id WHERE h.w_account_id = #{accountId} OR h.d_account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC
